Compute non-dominated Pareto frontier indicator

Source: R/06_optimizer.R
compute_pareto_frontier.Rd

Maximizes `combined_recall`, minimizes `pm_hits`. When `max_hits` is finite, restricts the frontier to queries with `pm_hits <= max_hits` (falling back to all valid queries only if none satisfy the cap).

Usage

compute_pareto_frontier(eval_df, max_hits = Inf)

Arguments

eval_df

Data frame / tibble of evaluated queries.

max_hits

Optional maximum PubMed hit count cap.

Value

Logical vector of length `nrow(eval_df)`.
